title: Loyal American fans and friends: Jim Blackman and the Bittemans
summary: Jim Blackman and Paul Lentz are devoted white fans from New Orleans. Mr. and Mrs. Bitteman in New York are like family, and their daughter Tina in France looks after festival people.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: Well, that's nice. That's better then them disappearing. Well listen, you may not have anything else to say about it but, as I said before, we talked about European fans. I mean you got some very faithful fans in America too.
Oh, haven't I though? In New Orleans, you met Jim, Jim Blackman?
No, but Paul is a friend of your's isn't he? Paul Lentz?
Yes.
No, I didn't meet Jim Blackman.
He comes to the Club all the time and he brings all his friends. He's been just like my brother.
Really?
Where ever I go he comes, to Florida, and brings his friends down there.

No this is a white fan.
Yeah. And when I was up for a Grammy here, well then they came out here to go to the Grammy Awards.

Yes. I don't know, it's just amazing and I have so many families. Now Mr. and Mrs. Bitteman they're in New York and they're just my family there.
From way back?
Yeah. You know, when I started coming.
Like the Cookery?
Yeah. And they call me all the time to see how I am. And when I get there she'll be cooking me all these goodies and stuff.
Where do they live?
They used to live in Manhattan. They live in Brooklyn now. Her daughter lives over in France.
Oh, do you see her over there?
Yeah. And she's a mother and they're grandparents now and that just tickles them to death.
Yes.
